text_simplified: The text discusses the importance of tarbiyah of children upon salah and their commitment to it. It points out that hitting is not an effective method of tarbiyah and may cause behavioral problems. Parents must use positive tarbiyah methods such as encouragement and dialogue to reinforce good behavior. Emphasis is placed on the good example (role model) and patience in teaching children.
